description:
"Bash guard BMX subculture" is a thing and the seeds for the Lineage Sport Bashguard were planted in 1992. In the here and now, this bike is designed to do everything it could then (and a lot of things it couldn't). All chromoly construction with a durable, replaceable nylon bash guard. A roomy 21" top tube length, hourglass mid BB shell, seatstay brake mounts and heat-treated chromoly forks are all ready for big riders to go big. The wheel set is era-correct and ready for action: Double wall rims, high flange hubs and 100PSI Haro HPF tires roll fast and stay tight. Bolt on Kneesaver bars, knurled alloy pegs and a collection of our Fusion parts line for a timeless BMX dream machine.
100% chromoly Lineage Sport frame with platform and bash guard, Mid BB shell, integrated head tube and Lineage cast dropouts with integrated chain tensioners. 21" top tube length
100% heat-treated chromoly Lineage fork with CNC 1-piece internal threaded steer tube, integrated bearing race, tapered legs, investment cast dropouts and 990 brake mounts with internal brake cable routing
100% heat-treated and butted chromoly Lineage Kneesaver bars 8.5" with Haro Lineage CNC alloy top load stem
Lineage Fusion alloy 175mm cranks with 22mm chromoly spindle. Haro Lineage Fusion Disc 39T CNC alloy bolt drive sprocket and sealed Mid BB
39/14 gearing
Fully sealed 36-hole wheels with Lineage high flange hubs, 14T cassette rear. Double-wall alloy rims
Haro HPF 100 psi tires 20 x 2.2" front and rear
Haro Lineage padded Pivotal stealth Fusion seat with alloy Lineage Pivotal fluted post
Haro Fusion alloy pedals
CNC alloy pegs
CNC alloy gyro with Teflon bearing
Haro Team grips
KMC K710SL super light chain
Dia-Compe Hombre FS996 (front) and AD996 (rear) brakes with Tech 77 levers
Haro Lineage two-bolt alloy seat post clamp
